subject.title: Admin: vista Data/Gráficas rota — dashboard de MongoDB Charts inexistente (error code 2)

question: Should Admin Data -> Gráficas remain as an Atlas Charts dashboard, or should the admin route be removed?
rationale: Both available fixes are mutually exclusive and depend on external Atlas/dashboard ownership rather than source-code evidence.

options.title: Replace the dashboard embed
options.body: Provide or recreate a valid embeddable MongoDB Charts dashboard ID and update Charts.tsx while preserving the admin route.

options.title: Remove the view
options.body: Delete the Charts screen and unregister the Data/Gráficas resource if this dashboard is no longer part of the admin product.

recommendation.title: Replace the dashboard embed
recommendation.body: Provide or recreate a valid embeddable MongoDB Charts dashboard ID and update Charts.tsx while preserving the admin route.

likelyOwner.reason: The current hardcoded embed line points to this current-main history, making them the best available routing candidate for the admin/data decision.
